verdict.rationale: Mirrors is an agent-tracing and context tool, so official instrumentation SDKs are a fair axis. The evidence never mentions an official SDK in any language. It only lists agent frameworks it is 'built for' (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, etc.) and says it works with existing traces, which does not establish officially supported Python and JS/TS SDKs.
